title: Azusawa Kohane — Lasting Heat〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Flea Market

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That last shop we visited was really fun!
They had so many old paintings and dolls.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To be honest, a couple were a little creepy...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I liked that nutcracker, since you don't really see those back home. Making its mouth clatter was fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You couldn't get enough of it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, look at this shop. They have all kinds of handicrafts.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, they're selling handmade accessories and handbags!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I guess this is the accessories section of the market.
Wanna check it out?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: These bead bracelets are so cute and colorful.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Look at that.
And they're reasonably priced. These might make for some great souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Souvenirs...
I know who'll really like these.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They come in a lot of different colors, so I think I'll get Ichika and her bandmates a set of matching ones.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You mean everyone from Leo/need?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought they'd like a gift that they can all wear together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, it should be fun to try and pick out the best colors for them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's a great idea! Alright, let's start with Hinomori... How about this one? I feel like cool colors suit her well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree. Oh, but... This one looks good, too. It's made with animal-shaped beads, see?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Animal beads? Where'd they even find those?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait a second. Maybe they also have beads shaped like musical instruments...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Good question...!
Let's see if they do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
As for gifts for the others...
How about these scented candles? Wouldn't they make for some good souvenirs?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, these smell so nice.
Let's see... This label says “Sweet Pea.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
How about this one...? Lemme see... “Ja-su-mi-ne”...
Oh, jasmine! That's what this smell is!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Jasmine?
That's supposed to have relaxing effects.
Minori and the others might like these a lot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They've been super busy with their idol work, so I'm sure they'd appreciate some relaxation goods!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe I should also get Haruka something...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I don't see why not.
This shop has a really big selection.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll find the perfect gift for her!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you say so, then I think I will take a look. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, these tote bags are a nice option, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
They're adorable...!
And each one has a different design printed on.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly!
They've got cute ones, cool ones and everything in between.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, this one has a basketball printed on it. Wouldn't this be the perfect choice for Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it would.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, is this an illustration of an amusement park?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's so cute and colorful.
And the artstyle is so gentle too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I think Emu would like this a lot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, it's just... Their faces keep popping into my head as we browse around like this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Same!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you think they're all up to right now? We text pretty often and they all sound pretty good, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really want to see them now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too. I can't wait to hear about everything that happened back home while we were over here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, and I can't wait to tell them about everything that happened over here too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I need to make sure I can properly talk about all the fun things we did and all the stuff we learned while we were over here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Including SONIC NOTES.
I need to see, hear and enjoy as much of it as I can today!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree!
